pages.text: The $(item)Rift Maw$() calls a creature out of the rift to be fought, and bound if I win.

pages.name: Rift Maw
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, crying obsidian on the corners.

pages.title: Lures
pages.text: Each creature answers to its own lure, made at the altar. I give the maw the lure and a blank familiar ring of its tier, pay the essence, and wait. The rift opens and it comes through.

pages.title: Inside the Wall
pages.text: A wall rises round the maw, 8 blocks out, 10 and 12 at the higher tiers. I cannot leave it. Fleeing is a loss, and so is dying, or taking more than five minutes.$(br2)A loss costs the lure and the essence, and the ring comes back blank. A win binds the creature into it.
